original_test_intent: Inject the approved GFX poison-with-ODECC condition and prove the intended OAM first records deferred UMC on-die ECC and then uncorrected GC poison consumption, with OOB and in-band agreement and no uncontrolled propagation.
original_method: Approve d0/b2/t8 poison semantics and physical map, capture complete protected OOB/in-band baselines, execute once, retain full command/system chronology, enumerate and securely decode every new CPER attachment, validate both ordered field matrices, reconcile in-band evidence, and assess health without clearing logs or reinjecting.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves poison semantics, expected two-record sequence, aborts, and recovery; operator monitors the dedicated SUT; owner/FAE reviews sequence integrity and decides the verdict.

Expected CPER count, order, timestamps, and causal window
Protected paginated Redfish schema and all-attachment retrieval
Dedicated window, propagation limits, console, power, and recovery
safety_requirements: Preserve complete baselines and all new entries

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED ONE-SHOT GFX POISON ODECC TWO-STAGE CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind one stimulus to immutable entry manifests, all decoded attachments, in-band CPER, and a health timeline that proves the deferred-to-consumed transition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces maximum-ID/index-plus-one shortcuts with complete cardinality/order and secure identity correlation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clears logs and relies on raw HTTP, a maximum-ID shortcut, malformed/plaintext transfer, and index +1 even though acceptance needs at least two correlated records. DeepSeek omits that dual-record sequence and its exact fields.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; mapping, packages, protected access, analyzer, sequence contract, approval, and recovery are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2085 Wistron-AMD SVM-00129-V003: approve d0/b2/t8 poison/ODECC mapping, protected CPER schema, expected count/order linking UMC ext0 On-die ECC Deferred to GC ext62 GfxGcError poison-consumed, in-band agreement, propagation aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves both producer and consumer error layers and converts the ambiguous maximum-ID check into complete ordered causality evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The UMC deferred record represents detection/storage of poisoned data, while GC ext62 represents later consumption; either alone proves only half the handling path. Because two records can be interleaved with unrelated CPER traffic, timestamps, OAM identity, entry cardinality, and full attachment decoding are required to prove they belong to one injection. Extra poison records are safety-relevant propagation, not harmless noise.
